data: Which of the following lines shows the lowest value at the year 1994?

The question asks which line shows the lowest value at the year 1994. From the caption, we know this is the NIST STT Benchmark Test History for May'09. Analyzing the key visual elements, there are multiple lines representing different speech recognition systems. The lines are colored differently, but their positions relative to each other can be observed. At the year 1994, the line labeled "All Travel Planning Kiosk Speech" appears to be positioned at the lowest point among all the lines. Therefore, the line showing the lowest value at the year 1994 is the one labeled "All Travel Planning Kiosk Speech."
